layout.basicDescription: A static canvas with explicit safe-area edges and a native Stack header.
layout.gradientHeaderDescription: The native Stack keeps Back and gestures while a semantic-token gradient renders behind its chrome.
layout.scrollDescription: A native-inset ScrollView that works under Stack headers and Native Tabs.
layout.formDescription: Keyboard-aware scrolling with a fixed, reachable action area.
layout.dynamicDescription: A route can update its native title without hiding the navigator configuration in a wrapper.

navigation.stackDescription: Settings owns a Stack, so pushed screens keep the selected native tab.
navigation.nativeTabsDescription: Five OS-owned tabs provide native chrome and independent nested stacks.
navigation.dynamicDescription: Route parameters identify an entity without duplicating it in navigation state.
navigation.sharedDescription: The same appointment route is rendered in Home or Calendar context.
navigation.absoluteRelativeDescription: Absolute typed paths are the production default; this relative link is documented for completeness.
navigation.deepLinkDescription: File-based routes are deep-linkable through the configured app scheme.
navigation.backDescription: Native Stack Back, gestures and Android Back should be the default behavior.
navigation.drawerDescription: There is no product scenario that justifies a Drawer alongside five primary tabs.

modals.standardDescription: Use for focused editing that should return to its origin.
modals.fullscreenDescription: Quick create owns a nested Stack while remaining one presented modal.
modals.formSheetDescription: Checkout uses two numeric detents and renders its title inside content for Android.
modals.confirmationDescription: React Native Modal is reserved for self-contained blocking decisions.
modals.sheetDescription: Gorhom Sheet is for previews, pickers and transient actions, not navigable flows.
modals.dismissDescription: Dismiss returns to the origin; dismissTo closes the whole nested flow to a known route.
modals.profileCreatedDescription: The post-onboarding modal: confetti, what to fill in, “Fill in profile”.
modals.creatingDescription: The end-of-onboarding animation over the saved draft; writes nothing.

auth.restorationDescription: A dedicated protected loading route prevents auth or onboarding flashes.
auth.protectedDescription: App routes exist only while session and profile guards are true.
auth.publicDescription: Sign-in routes exist only while there is no active session.
auth.returnToDescription: A validated internal deep link is remembered through sign-in and onboarding.
auth.signOutDescription: Protected history will be removed and Back cannot reopen the app.

recommended.screen: Use for headerless static content; pass only the safe-area edges the navigator does not own.
recommended.gradientHeader: Configure transparency, tint, status bar and background explicitly in the owning Stack layout.
recommended.scroll: Use for content that scrolls under a native header.
recommended.form: Use for forms; keep navigation prevention in the route.
recommended.stackOptions: Keep title, header, gesture and animation options in the route or layout.
recommended.stack: Use a nested Stack when a tab needs headers or push navigation.
recommended.nativeTabs: Keep the alpha API isolated and avoid custom tab backgrounds.
recommended.dynamic: Pass serializable identifiers through typed route params.
recommended.shared: Use the group-qualified href when the origin tab must be preserved.
recommended.absolute: Prefer absolute typed paths in production code.
recommended.deepLink: Test custom-scheme links in a development build, not Expo Go.
recommended.back: Prefer native Back; intercept only local wizard steps or unsaved changes.
recommended.drawer: Do not add a navigator without a real information-architecture need.
recommended.routeModal: Configure presentation in the parent Stack, not in a content wrapper.
recommended.fullscreen: Use for long, focused multi-step creation flows.
recommended.formSheet: Keep detents numeric and limit Android to three or fewer.
recommended.rnModal: Use only for self-contained alerts and confirmations.
recommended.sheet: Use for transient overlays that are not deep-linkable.
recommended.dismiss: Use dismiss for origin return and dismissTo for a known terminal route.
recommended.authRestore: Keep the root navigator mounted while session state resolves.
recommended.protected: Treat protected routes as client navigation control, not backend authorization.
recommended.publicRoute: Keep auth UI in its own public Stack and canonical URL namespace.
recommended.returnTo: Validate the target as an internal path before imperative replacement.
recommended.signOut: Let guard changes clear protected history; do not push the sign-in route manually.
recommended.preview: A flow screen preview: the same component, no database writes.
